createEntityAwareMapper:
/**
 * Entity-aware mapper factory. Builds a reverse map from DB column (snake_case)
 * back to the entity field name as defined in the schema.
 *
 * This ensures `fromBackendRow` returns keys that match entity field names —
 * so `filterVisibleFields` can find them regardless of whether the entity
 * uses snake_case (`first_name`) or camelCase (`firstName`) field names.
 *
 * Write paths (`toBackendField`, `toBackendKeys`) are shared with the default mapper.
 *
 * @param entityFieldNames - Field names from the entity schema (use `getEntityFieldNames(schema)`)
 */
export declare function createEntityAwareMapper(entityFieldNames: string[]): SupabaseFieldMapper;
defaultFieldMapper:
/** Default mapper (camelToSnake) for use by adapters and edge functions */
export declare const defaultFieldMapper: SupabaseFieldMapper;
getEntityFieldNames:
/**
 * Extract entity field names from a Valibot schema.
 * Works with any schema that has an `entries` property (object schemas).
 * Returns empty array if schema is missing or has no entries.
 *
 * @param schema - Valibot schema (or undefined)
 * @returns Array of entity field name strings
 */
export declare function getEntityFieldNames(schema: unknown): string[];
createBrowserClient:
/**
 * Create the app's Supabase client with the auth session stored in cookies.
 * Use it instead of `createClient` in the app's provider setup; the server then knows
 * the signed-in state on the first render (no signed-out flash), and "remember me"
 * works ({@link setSessionOnly}).
 *
 * @param url - Project URL (`https://<ref>.supabase.co`)
 * @param publicKey - Publishable (or legacy anon) key
 *
 * @version 0.2.0
 * @since 0.1.46
 * @author AMBROISE PARK Consulting
 */
export declare function createBrowserClient(url: string, publicKey: string): SupabaseClient;
createServerClient:
/**
 * Create a Supabase client with the secret key (sb_secret_...) or service_role key (legacy) for server-side auth admin.
 * Use this only on the server (Node.js); never expose the secret key to the client.
 *
 * @param url - Supabase project URL
 * @param secretKey - Secret key (sb_secret_...) or service_role key (legacy)
 *
 * @version 0.1.0
 * @since 0.0.1
 */
export declare function createServerClient(url: string, secretKey: string): SupabaseClient;
createPublicServerClient:
/**
 * Create a server-side Supabase client with the publishable (or legacy anon) key.
 * Reads run as the anonymous role, so RLS returns only public rows and columns.
 *
 * @param url - Project URL (`https://<ref>.supabase.co`)
 * @param publicKey - Publishable (sb_publishable_...) or legacy anon key, never the secret key
 * @returns Supabase client without session persistence
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * const crud = new SupabaseCrudAdapter(createPublicServerClient(url, publicKey));
 * ```
 *
 * @version 0.1.0
 * @since 0.2.3
 */
export declare function createPublicServerClient(url: string, publicKey: string): SupabaseClient;
readSupabaseSessionCookie:
/**
 * Signed-in state from a Cookie header, for a Supabase client whose session lives in
 * cookies (`createBrowserClient`). Reads `sb-<ref>-auth-token` (whole or chunked `.0`,
 * `.1`…, optionally `base64-` encoded). Not verified: display only, data access stays
 * enforced by RLS. Redirect decisions use refreshSupabaseSession, which verifies first.
 *
 * A session whose access token has expired is not a signed-in user: the refresh token
 * may be dead, and only a refresh tells (the proxy's refreshSupabaseSession, or the
 * browser client). It reads as "cannot tell", so the client waits for the provider.
 * Behind the generated proxy the render always gets a refreshed, valid cookie.
 *
 * @param cookieHeader - The request's `Cookie` header
 * @returns `{ user: null }` signed out, `{ user, accessToken? }` signed in with an
 * unexpired access token, `null` cannot tell (expired or undated session, several
 * projects' cookies, partially written cookie)
 *
 * @version 0.2.0
 * @since 0.2.3
 */
export declare function readSupabaseSessionCookie(cookieHeader: string): AuthSessionSnapshot | null;
hasSupabaseSessionCookie:
/**
 * Whether a request carries a Supabase auth cookie (`sb-<ref>-auth-token`, whole or
 * chunked). No cookie: the visitor is signed out, nothing to verify or refresh, and
 * the generated proxy serves the cached guest render. Name check only: the session
 * itself is verified by {@link refreshSupabaseSession}.
 *
 * @param request - The proxy request (Next `NextRequest`)
 * @returns `true` when an auth cookie is present
 *
 * @version 0.1.0
 * @since 0.2.3
 */
export declare function hasSupabaseSessionCookie(request: {
    cookies: Pick<ProxyRequestCookies, 'getAll'>;
}
refreshSupabaseSession:
/**
 * Verify, and refresh when expired, the Supabase session of a proxy request. Call it
 * once per request, before any redirect decision, then forward the request
 * (`NextResponse.next({ request })`, `NextResponse.rewrite(url, { request })`) and pass
 * every returned response through `apply`.
 *
 * - Valid session: unchanged cookies, signed in.
 * - Expired access token: refreshed by @supabase/ssr, new cookies on the request and
 *   the response, signed in. Refresh failure: @supabase/ssr clears the cookies, signed out.
 * - Session the server refuses (revoked, user deleted): signed out; the auth cookies
 *   are dropped from the forwarded request so the render agrees (the browser client
 *   settles its own cookies).
 * - Supabase unreachable: cannot tell, cookies untouched.
 *
 * "Remember me" off (session-only cookie present): rewritten auth cookies stay session
 * cookies, as in the browser client.
 *
 * @param request - The proxy request (Next `NextRequest`)
 * @param url - Project URL (`https://<ref>.supabase.co`)
 * @param publicKey - Publishable (or legacy anon) key
 * @returns The verdict and the response writer
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * const auth = await refreshSupabaseSession(request, url, publicKey);
 * if (!auth.session?.user) return auth.apply(NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url)));
 * return auth.apply(NextResponse.next({ request }));
 * ```
 *
 * @version 0.1.0
 * @since 0.2.3
 */
export declare function refreshSupabaseSession(request: {
    cookies: ProxyRequestCookies;
}
